topStories.headline: Meta Surges 10%+ on Plan to Launch AI Cloud Business Selling Surplus Compute
topStories.summary: Bloomberg reported Meta Platforms is creating 'Meta Compute,' an internal cloud business selling excess AI computing capacity to enterprises, setting up direct competition with AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.
topStories.marketImpact: META ↑ ~10–11%, adding ~$179B market cap; cloud competition bearish for AMZN, MSFT, GOOGL; AI infrastructure narrative ↑

topStories.headline: Chip Stocks Tumble on Profit-Taking After Historic Q2 AI Rally; Antitrust Suit Adds Pressure
topStories.summary: Micron fell 8%, SanDisk dropped 10%, and the iShares Semiconductor ETF slid 4.7% as investors locked in gains at the Q3 open; a class-action antitrust lawsuit filed June 25 against Micron, Samsung, and SK Hynix for alleged DRAM price-fixing compounded the selloff.
topStories.marketImpact: MU ↓ 8%, SNDK ↓ 10%, WDC ↓ 7%, AMD ↓, INTC ↓; SOXX ↓ 4.7%; memory sector under near-term pressure

topStories.headline: June Nonfarm Payrolls Released Today at 8:30am ET; ADP Showed Soft 98K Private Hires
topStories.summary: The BLS June employment situation report is the key macro event of the holiday-shortened week; yesterday's ADP private payrolls came in at 98K — below the 110K forecast — and the consensus for today's NFP is ~115K with unemployment expected steady at 4.3%.
topStories.marketImpact: Watch: US equities ↓ risk if strong (rate hike fears); Treasury yields ↑ on beat; USD ↑ on strong print; SPY, QQQ, TLT sensitive

topStories.headline: Fed Chair Warsh Says Inflation 'Too High,' Declines to Hint at July Rate Move at ECB Forum
topStories.summary: In his first major international address as Fed Chair, Kevin Warsh appeared at the ECB Forum in Sintra, Portugal alongside ECB's Lagarde and BoE's Bailey, stated prices remain 'too high,' and gave no forward guidance on whether the FOMC will hike at its July 28–29 meeting.
topStories.marketImpact: July rate hike probability ~11%; USD ↑ bias; GLD ↓ pressure; TLT ↓ watch; rate-sensitive equities cautious

topStories.headline: SK Hynix Plans Record $29B Nasdaq ADR Listing Under Ticker SKHY on July 10
topStories.summary: SK Hynix, the world's second-largest memory chipmaker with ~60% of the HBM AI chip market, is targeting a July 10 Nasdaq ADR listing at up to $29.4B — which would surpass Alibaba's 2014 IPO as the largest ADR offering in history.
topStories.marketImpact: MU ↓ on investor rotation risk; HBM market ↑ competitive visibility; AI memory capex narrative ↑; Nasdaq liquidity dynamics to watch

topStories.headline: Oil Stabilises Near $74 as US-Iran Doha Peace Talks Continue; Weekend Hormuz Clashes Unsettle Markets
topStories.summary: Brent crude steadied near $73–74/barrel after crashing 30% in Q2 — its worst quarter since 2020 — as a 60-day US-Iran interim agreement keeps the Strait of Hormuz partially open, though weekend clashes damaged two vessels and have renewed uncertainty around the Doha talks.
topStories.marketImpact: Energy sector ↑ watch; Brent spike risk if talks collapse; oil-inflation pass-through could complicate Fed July decision

topStories.headline: China June Manufacturing PMI Rises to 50.3 — Third Consecutive Month of Expansion
topStories.summary: China's official NBS Manufacturing PMI edged up to 50.3 in June from 50.0, beating estimates of 50.1; new orders returned to expansion territory (51.2 vs 49.9 in May), driven by strong AI-linked high-tech exports even as domestic demand remains subdued.
topStories.marketImpact: China tech ↑ on AI export strength; domestic consumption recovery tentative; FXI, BABA cautiously positive

companiesToWatch.name: Micron Technology

companiesToWatch.name: NVIDIA

companiesToWatch.name: Amazon
